name: Forest honey
summary: Forest honey is one of the goods Thai and Muong sellers bring to Phố Đoàn, with dried bamboo shoot and banana flower.
origin: Phố Đoàn market, xã Pù Luông. Source: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 26 Sep 2026.
howToEat: Buy it at the market to carry home.
where: Phố Đoàn market, on Thursday and Sunday.
seoTitle: Forest honey at Pho Doan — a market good
seoDescription: Mật ong, forest honey, is sold by Thai and Muong sellers at Phố Đoàn on Thursday and Sunday.
